table.name: November: CNN only, AI course (7 lectures, 250 pictures)

method:
Image model of StudyMate: which course / lecture is this slide photo from?

  CNN   : MobileNetV2 (ImageNet weights, transfer learning) -> 1280 features -> softmax head (logistic regression),
          trained on the training slides + 3 photo-like augmented copies of each.
  OCR   : Tesseract reads the photo -> TF-IDF (words + letters) -> logistic regression trained on the text of the
          training slides and the course question banks.
  Fusion: log p = log p_ocr + w * log p_cnn, w chosen on a validation set taken from the training slides.
Test    : 20 % of the slides (never used for training or for choosing w), as phone-like photos.
